name: boolean_negation
description: Evaluate a single Boolean negation from literal True/False with varied variable names; matched controls copy a numeric value in the same Python assignment format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
p='Predict the Python output.
a = True
print(not a)
Output: False

b = False
print(not b)
Output: True

'
cp='Predict the Python output.
a = 3
print(a)
Output: 3

b = 5
print(b)
Output: 5

'
for i in range(100):
 var=random.choice(['flag','value','ready','active','enabled','valid','state','test'])+str(i);x=bool(i%2);n=random.randint(1,99)
 items.append({'prompt':p+f'{var} = {x}
print(not {var})
Output:','answer':' '+str(not x)})
 controls.append({'prompt':cp+f'{var} = {n}
print({var})
Output:','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
